composition_variation: Illustrate an original 25-year-old anime woman with a high curly ponytail, holding a basketball against one hip on an empty outdoor court. She wears an opaque saffron long-sleeved athletic top, loose full-length navy track pants, and high-top sneakers. Use energetic graphic anime linework, sky-blue court paint, coral shadows, and warm late-afternoon light. Her feet are planted naturally and her open smile communicates sporty self-confidence. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
